description: Full detail for up to 25 products: all specifications in the category's standard order (card_specs first), review-derived ratings with verbatim evidence quotes, every seller offer with price and buy_url, and attribute_provenance recording where each spec value came from (manufacturer page, retailer listing, spec table). ids accepts product ids and shelf row ids alike: a group row's id resolves to the product the row is named after (its top_pick_id), and resolved_groups reports each substitution. Responses that carry buy_url links also carry a disclosure field: the commission disclosure for those links.

user_signature.description: Optional opaque, stable, pseudonymous user id: the shopper's own rate-limit quota and click attribution. Format: 'sv1-' + the first 24 hex characters of SHA-256('swervie/v1|' + normalized identifier), or 'sv1r-' + a UUID. A raw email or phone number is hashed server-side before anything is stored.
